title: Team Collaboration
retroComingSoon: Retrospective / review workspace is coming soon.
retroDescription: Periodic debriefs, gap analysis, and action tracking linked to BSC and PBC.

retro.title: Monthly Retrospective (Team-wide)
retro.groupScopeNote: Shared across the whole team · one per month
retro.supabaseRequired: Retrospectives are stored in Supabase. Set VITE_DEPLOYMENT_DOMAIN and VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY, apply the team_retro_boards migration, then refresh.
retro.saveError: Could not save the retrospective. Please try again.
retro.readOnlyHint: Read-only view. You need access to this workspace (active group member, group admin, or system admin) to edit.

placeholder.teamDesc: Team-wide notes — all members can contribute…
placeholder.improvement: Improvement direction or actions to track…

customer.title: Customer & External
customer.guide1: What friction or blockers arose in client communications or visits?
customer.guide2: Did opportunity follow-ups go smoothly? Any unexpected lost or delayed deals?
customer.guide3: Did any clients raise unexpected requirements or issues?

goals.title: Goals & Cycle Review
goals.guide1: Were this month's PBC targets met? Where did gaps appear?
goals.guide2: Were there planned actions that were not executed?
goals.guide3: Did any unexpected events or situations arise?

execution.title: Execution & Collaboration
execution.guide1: What key events or blockers impacted progress?
execution.guide2: Was cross-team collaboration smooth? Any coordination gaps?
execution.guide3: Did any unexpected issues arise in a specific area, and how were they resolved?

data.title: Data & Operations
data.guide1: Were there anomalies, gaps, or quality issues in CRM or map data?
data.guide2: Are there any operational risks that need prompt follow-up?

tech.title: Tech & Process
tech.guide1: Are there unresolved technical issues that need handover or tracking?
tech.guide2: Which parts of system integrations or automation need improvement?
tech.guide3: For any technical issues, have the relevant parties been notified for next retro tracking?

scoringRubric.title: Scoring Rubric
scoringRubric.desc5: Fully completed all targets; achieved breakthrough results; set a benchmark for others; recognised across teams.
scoringRubric.desc4: Completed targets at 90%+; some work items exceeded expectations; most deliverables on time.
scoringRubric.desc3: Completed targets at 80%; work quality meets the standard; meets expectations on time.
scoringRubric.desc2: Completed targets at 70–80%; missed at least one key item; partial completion.
scoringRubric.desc1: Completed targets below 60%; most work not completed; unable to fulfil commitments.
